problem:
The amount of charge stored in a battery is decreasing due to self-discharge. The rate at which the amount of stored charge decays $W(t),$ after $t$ months, can be modeled by the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}W}{\text{d}t}=-0.025W.
$$

How long does it take for the amount of stored charge to be $75%$ of the original amount? Round your answer to the nearest month.
